lesson: A completion that is positive by construction moves all content into its defect against the data, and the positivity lemma reads only the defect's smallest eigenvalue. An off-line quartet enters that through a pair form that vanishes with eta, so the device can prove only N(theta) with tolerance, which ZQ satisfies (forced on paper before the runs, then confirmed). The two-sided defect does exclude every pair, but it is the target in the window. Mode count: completion verdicts do not change with m; data-form chain pass rates fall with m (0 of 192 at M = 0, theta >= 0.80, m = 384).
